semantic_fragments.content: The Infrared Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by health care providers.

When the PT2L infrared thermometer project was launched, we planned risk management activities for the product and formulated a risk management plan. Currently, the PT2L infrared thermometer is in the feasibility review stage of design changes. The purpose of this risk management review is to determine whether the design changes of the PT2L infrared thermometer will generate new risks or affect the original risks, and to analyze and evaluate, and propose a risk control plan to ensure that the product risk is minimized during the design changes.

Criteria for risk evaluation: Please find the document Risk Management Plan (PT2L-FXJH01 V1.0) for the risk acceptance criteria. Severity levels: 1 negligible; 2 minor; 3 Serious; 4 Critical; 5 Catastrophic. Probability levels: 6 Frequent; 5 Probable; 4 Occasional; 3 Remote; 2 Improbable; 1 Few.

Bibliography and questions from the following standards are used to identify medical device characteristics that could impact on safety and intended use: Annex A of ISO/TR 24971:2020, IEC 60601-1:2005+AMD1:2012+AMD2:2020 Edition 3.2, IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 edition 4.1, IEC 60601-1-11:2015+A1:2020.

Bibliography / Referenced Standards: Safety: IEC 60601-1:2005+AMD1:2012+AMD2:2020 edition 3.2, IEC 60601-1-11:2015+A1:2020; EMC: IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020 edition 4.1; Risk Management: ISO 14971:2019 / EN ISO 14971:2019, ISO/TR24971:2020; Specialized standard: ISO 80601-2-56:2017/Amd1:2018, ASTM E1965-98(2016).

ISO/TR 24971:2020 Annex A 特性识别问卷回答摘要：
- A.2.1 预期用途：PT2L用于体温测量，不建议用于测量部位有局部病变（如炎症、外伤、术后等）的人员；不用于维持或支持生命；信息安全失效可影响数据保密性及性能/可用性；未授权访问或数据丢失可影响设备安全。涉及危害：电能、机械能、生物制剂、化学制剂、免疫制剂、数据、功能性。
- A.2.2 非植入设备。
- A.2.3 与患者皮肤短时接触。涉及危害：化学制剂、免疫制剂。
- A.2.4 不与其他材料/组件接触，不与组织或体液接触，未使用动物源性材料。
- A.2.5 从患者获取红外线（电磁波），测量时间有限，能量水平不高于同类设备。涉及危害：电磁波。
- A.2.6 不用于物质输送或提取。
- A.2.7 不处理生物材料。
- A.2.8 非无菌供应。
- A.2.9 需要常规清洁和消毒探头。涉及危害：生物制剂、化学制剂、免疫制剂。
- A.2.10 不改变患者环境。
- A.2.11 测量体温。涉及危害：数据、功能性。
- A.2.12 不进行分析处理。
- A.2.13 不与其他医疗器械、药品或医疗技术联合使用。
- A.2.14 存在非预期能量输出，包括非电离辐射、电能和热能；无非预期物质输出。涉及危害：辐射能、电能、热能。
- A.2.15 对温度、湿度、电磁干扰、大气压、振动、灰尘、光线和昆虫等环境因素敏感。涉及危害：辐射能、功能性。
- A.2.16 通过电磁辐射、电池使用和报废影响环境。涉及危害：辐射能、化学制剂。
- A.2.17 需要电池作为消耗品/附件。涉及危害：功能性、热能。
- A.2.18 需要由经过培训的专业人员进行校准。涉及危害：功能性。

A.2.19: 医疗器械包含软件。对于非联网型号，无需安装和验证。但对于应用App连接型号或蓝牙型号，需要进行软件安装和验证。A.2.20: 仅具有蓝牙功能的型号允许访问信息。A.2.21: 医疗器械存储体温测量数据。A.2.22: 仅有使用寿命，无限定货架寿命。A.2.23: 存在延迟或长期使用效果，如标签磨损。A.2.24: 不受机械力影响。A.2.25: 使用寿命由元器件老化决定。A.2.26: 非一次性使用设备。A.2.27: 需要对医疗器械本身进行适当处置，并对存储数据进行充分处理。A.2.28: 无需特殊培训或技能。A.2.29: 安全使用信息通过制造商提供的用户手册直接提供给最终用户，无需额外培训。A.2.30: 未建立或引入新的制造工艺。A.2.31: 成功应用不依赖于用户界面的可用性。A.2.31.1: 用户界面设计特征不会导致使用错误。A.2.31.2: 不在可能因干扰导致使用错误的紧急医疗环境中使用。A.2.31.3: 无连接部件或附件。A.2.31.4: 无控制界面。A.2.31.5: 医疗器械显示测量值和警告信息。A.2.31.6: 仅有简单按钮或直接控制操作，不通过菜单控制。A.2.31.7: 成功使用不依赖于用户的知识、技能和能力。A.2.31.8: 不由有特殊需求的人员使用。A.2.31.9: 用户界面不允许访问受限操作模式，因此无法启动未经授权的操作。
A.2.32: 医疗器械包含技术报警系统。A.2.33: 可能的误用方式包括：用于非预期人群、不当环境、不当维护或连接失败。A.2.34: 为便携式设备。A.2.35: 医疗器械的使用依赖于基本性能。A.2.36: 启动测量后，医疗器械自动执行测量过程，遇到问题时发出误警报。A.2.37: 医疗器械的输出不作为确定临床行动的输入。

IEC 60601-1相关问题：4.3 基本性能：依据ISO 80601-2-56:2017+A1:2018/EN ISO 80601-2-56:2017/A1:2020 第201.4.3.101、201.101.2条，临床温度计的准确度为基本性能。4.4 预期服务寿命为5年。4.5 标准要求的风险控制措施或测试方法无需替代手段。4.6 施力部分为按键，外壳也可被触摸，但按键和外壳无需满足施力部分要求。4.7 单一故障条件（除标准13.2条识别的以外）包括：温度限制装置故障。4.8 所有元器件按照其规定额定值和标准使用。4.9 无高完整性特性部件。5.1 不会发生同时故障的组合。

7.2.2 Identification: The foreseeable misuse of marking of label was considered. 7.2.13 Physiological effects (safety signs and warning): The EUT is not producing physiological effects. 7.2.17 Protective packaging: Have special handling instruction for transportation or storage needed. Premature removal of packaging does not pose an unacceptable risk to the product or accessories. 7.3.3 Batteries: Lithium battery has warning labels. Dry battery has no warning labels. 7.4.2 Control devices: The switches indicated by symbols. 7.5 Safety signs: Warning, Prohibition, Mandatory action are used.

7.9.2.4 Electrical power source: Whether the leakage of the battery would lead to an unacceptable risk? Does loss of power pose an unacceptable risk? Yes, include: Low battery; Battery leakage - the risk of battery leakage is acceptable, the instruction manual should include a 'warning to remove the battery if it is not possible to use the ME device for a certain period of time'; Loss of power can lead to unacceptable risk, design to allow for rapid release of pressure when loss of power.

8.8.4.1 What type(s) of insulation for the medical device require specific test protocols, other than these required by the IEC/EN 60601-1, for verifying their resistance to heat during the expected service life of the medical device? Reinforced insulation case. 8.10.1 What components of the medical device are securely mounted for the expected service lifetime of the medical device? Inner lead component.

9.2.1 Moving parts: Moving part cannot be touched. 9.2.3.1 Unintended movement: Controls are positioned, recessed, or protected by other means so that they cannot be accidentally actuated - Yes, No unacceptable risk is created. 9.6.1 Noise and vibration levels generated by the medical device: ≦80dBA. 9.6.2.2 Parts that are source of infrasound and ultrasound: No source of infrasound and ultrasound.

10.6 What parts of the medical device produce infrared radiation? Infrared probe. All other radiation sources (X-radiation 10.1.2, alpha/beta/gamma/neutron 10.2, microwave 10.3, visible electromagnetic 10.5, ultraviolet 10.7) are confirmed as not present in the device.

8.5.2.2: No type-B applied part device. 8.5.2.3: No patient leads. 8.6.3: No moving parts that are protectively earthed. 9.2.2.1: No trapping zone. 9.2.2.4: No guards required. 9.2.2.6: No parts used to position the patient. 9.2.4: No emergency stopping device. 9.2.5: No means for releasing the patient quickly. 9.5.1: No expelled parts. 9.7.2: No pneumatic or hydraulic parts. 9.7.7: No pressure relief devices. 9.8.1/9.8.2/9.8.3.1/9.8.5: No structural support parts. 10.1.2/10.2/10.3/10.5/10.7: No relevant radiation sources. 11.1.1 (table 23/24): No applied parts covering more than 10% of body surface area.
11.1.3: 测试角落对医疗器械及附近表面加热的影响（考虑使用条件）：影响医疗器械附近的通风。接触概率与接触时长：测量体温时必须接触按键和外壳，外壳接触时间<1分钟，按键接触时间<1分钟，温度符合IEC 60601-1表22和表23的要求。
11.6.5: 防水和防尘等级为IP22，防止水或颗粒物进入医疗设备及系统。
11.6.6: 多次清洁/消毒后医疗器械及其零部件和附件不受损坏，在预期使用寿命内多次清洁/消毒后不损坏。
11.6.7: 正常使用和可预见误用中无需灭菌的部件。
11.3: 设备功耗小于15W，不存在火灾风险，无构成防火外壳的零件。
12.1: 医疗器械控制器和仪表精度相关风险：体温测量不准确，导致用户获得错误结果。
14.1 可编程电气医疗系统（PEMS）通用要求：存在测量不准确、不适当报警的风险。14.6.1 已知和可预见危险识别：测量不准确、不适当报警。14.6.2 风险控制措施：软件验证报告。14.7 需求规范：体温计误差限值。14.8 架构：保护性设计。14.9 设计与实现：软件验证报告。14.10 验证：软件验证报告。14.11 PEMS验证：软件验证报告。
15.4.3.1: 电池仓或外壳中存在孔洞、间隙等结构，为充电或放电时可能排出气体的电池提供通风外壳。15.4.3.2: 电池连接。15.4.3.3: 无过充电保护部件。

Excluded environments: The device cannot be used near active HF SURGICAL EQUIPMENT and the RF shielded room of an ME SYSTEM for magnetic resonance imaging, where the intensity of EM DISTURBANCES is high.

BASIC SAFETY pass/fail criteria for immunity testing includes: ACCESSIBLE PARTS including APPLIED PARTS, CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES, Dielectric strength, Measurements of LEAKAGE CURRENTS and PATIENT AUXILIARY CURRENTS.

Operating modes during immunity testing: Emission - The EUT was configured to measure its highest possible emission level, test conditions adapted per instructions for use. Immunity - The EUT was configured to have its highest possible susceptibility against tested phenomena, test conditions adapted per instructions for use.

IMMUNITY TEST LEVELS (IEC 60601-1-2 clause 8.9): The environment of intended use is Professional healthcare facility environment and Home healthcare environment, which will not alter the EM disturbance levels specified in the collateral standard. The electromagnetic immunity tests were performed on the thermometer as defined in the user manual.

Proximity fields from RF wireless communications equipment (IEC 60601-1-2 clause 8.10): No additional frequencies and communications are encountered. Electromagnetic immunity tests were performed on the thermometer as defined in the user manual.
Proximity magnetic fields in the frequency range 9 kHz to 13.56 MHz (IEC 60601-1-2 clause 8.11): This product does not have any components or circuitry susceptible to magnetic fields.

EMC testing configuration for products of different series: Products of different series will be tested separately. If products belong to the same series (e.g., similar circuit, similar function), the product which can cover comprehensive circuit and functions will be selected for testing.
Environmental conditions of transport and storage (IEC 60601-1-11:2015+A1:2020 clause 4.2.2): Based on regulations ISO 80601-2-56:2017/Amd1:2018 and ASTM E1965-98(2016).

EUT electromagnetic compatibility compliance: The EUT has been tested and complies with the standard IEC 60601-1-2. Output circuit accidental and prolonged operation does not pose a dangerous situation. There is no non-luminous heater. No pre-set controls are provided for the medical device. Not a medical system. No connection terminals or connectors subject to clause 16.9.1.

Risk analysis table section 4.1 Energy hazards covers: Electromagnetic energy, Electrostatic discharge, Radiated RF EM fields, Conducted disturbances induced by RF fields, Proximity fields from RF wireless communications, Rated Power-frequency Magnetic Field, Proximity magnetic fields immunity test, Leakage current, Separation parts, Parts contacting patient, Temperature of parts, Temperature of applied parts, Mechanical strength, Inner lead, Component fixing, Protective measures components, Infrared radiation. Several sub-categories are listed as N/A: Acoustic energy, Moving parts, Lithium battery, Suspended masses, Vibration, Stored Energy, Torsion/shear/tensile force, Moving and positioning of patient, Ultrasonic energy, Infrasound energy, High pressure fluid injection.

Risk analysis table section 4.2 Biological and chemical hazards covers: Allergenicity/Irritancy (biocompatibility not qualified), Allergenicity/Irritancy (cross-infection risk). Several sub-categories are listed as N/A: Bacteria, Viruses, Other agents, Exposure of airway/tissues/environment/property to foreign materials, Degradation products/medical gas/anesthesia products, Pyrogenicity.

Environment condition risk R30 requires the device to be in accordance with the requirement for environment conditions in ISO 80601-2-56:2017/Amd1:2018, covering working, transportation and storage conditions to prevent device damage, measurement inaccuracy, or fire/scald hazards.

Section 4.4 Information hazards covers risks arising from accompanying documents and markings on the outside of the device, including: hard-to-understand labeling, marking abrasion or poor adhesion, inadequate disclosure of limitations, and inadequate specification of intended use. All such risks can result in users being unable to operate the device correctly and failing to obtain accurate measurement results.

The following hazard categories were assessed as N/A (not applicable) in this fragment: Construction of connectors, reproducibility, Incorrect or inappropriate output or functionality, Interruption of the power supply, Strangling or asphyxia.

For each unacceptable Risk, we have considered risk control measures according to the principle of section 3.3 'Risk Acceptance Criteria' in RMP. For each acceptable risk, we have further implemented risk control measures. So I think we have reduced the risk AFAP.

Risk Management Conclusion: According to the risk acceptance table, the risk levels before control are distributed as follows — R50 at Frequent/Serious; R36 at Occasional/Minor; multiple risks (R9,R10,R11,R13,R15,R16,R17,R18,R20,R21,R22,R26,R27,R28,R29,R30,R33,R34,R37,R39,R40,R42,R43,R44,R46,R51,R52,R53) at Occasional/Serious; R23 at Remote/Minor; R24,R38,R54 at Remote/Serious; R3,R8 at Remote/Critical; R12,R19,R25,R31,R32,R35,R41,R45,R47,R48,R49 at Improbable/Serious; R1,R2,R4,R5,R6,R7,R14 at Improbable/Critical. Risks in white background area are ACC (acceptable); others need to be controlled. According to the above risk analysis and assessment, the software security level is determined as B.
